title: ELLIS PhD Program: Call for Applications 2026
institution: ELLIS (European Laboratory for Learning and Intelligent Systems)
about: ELLIS has opened its 2026 PhD Program call for entry in 2027. Applicants apply online through the ELLIS application portal; reference requests must be submitted before the deadline, and the network spans European AI labs with an international exchange component.
